content.title: Fatigue Pose Relay | One Body State Across Locations
content.summary: One clearly adult subject carries the same tired posture and identity across a sequence of supporting objects and places.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult subject, outfit and carried bag persist. + Fatigue posture carries across every location. + Each new prop supports rather than transforms the subject. + Location changes are discrete chapters, not identity swaps. + The final resting container preserves safe anatomy and clear identity.
quick_start.recommended_input: An adult park surveyor rests across four playground supports and ends in a ball cart.
required_anchors: 服装包袋与人物身份不变
支撑物变化不得造成身份替换
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: One clearly adult subject carries the same tired posture and identity across a sequence of supporting objects and places.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 锁定同一明确成年人物与疲惫身体状态，让多个地点物件依次成为支撑面；每次换地点都保留服装、包袋和下坠姿态，最终在最意外容器中安静停住。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One clearly adult subject, outfit and carried bag persist.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One clearly adult subject, outfit and carried bag persist."

invariants.rule: Fatigue posture carries across every location.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Fatigue posture carries across every location."

invariants.rule: Each new prop supports rather than transforms the subject.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Each new prop supports rather than transforms the subject."

invariants.rule: Location changes are discrete chapters, not identity swaps.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Location changes are discrete chapters, not identity swaps."

invariants.rule: The final resting container preserves safe anatomy and clear identity.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final resting container preserves safe anatomy and clear identity."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: all source faces, bodies, wardrobe, identities and creator-specific character designs
the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
